content.short: ADA Invadaz is a collection of 3D CNFTs from outer space, on the Cardano blockchain.
content.description:
The Invadaz come from the Lupus-Major Planetary Cluster, hundreds of billions of miles from Earth. They are here to fight FUD and defend the Cardano Blockchain for the good of the intergalactic community. Each season will bring a unique alien species from a different planet. ADA Invadaz holders will be eligible for a unique holder benefits programme including ADA drops and giveaways as well as unique IRL prizes.

A full roadmap and vision can be found on our discord.
